item.title: Deploy Azure resources with Meshery
item.description:
In this tutorial, you deploy Azure resources from a Meshery Design. Meshery manages Azure resources through Azure Service Operator (ASO), which represents each Azure resource, such as a Storage Account, Key Vault, or SQL Server, as a Kubernetes custom resource. You install ASO in your cluster, give it an Azure identity, and then design and deploy Azure resources from Meshery.

Before you begin

  • Meshery, deployed by following the installation guides, with a Kubernetes cluster connected to it. In Meshery UI, the cluster appears as Connected under Lifecycle → Connections.
  • kubectl, configured for the same cluster.
  • An Azure subscription to create resources in.
  • The Azure CLI, signed in with az login.
